facts.fact: The first live government-to-person grant payments went through Namibia's instant payment network on 17 June 2026, to beneficiaries in the Marginalised Beneficiaries grant category, via Bank Windhoek, in a controlled go-live.
facts.system: Government grant payments over the instant payment network (Marginalised Beneficiaries grant)
